note: Seventy residence drawings and four community or phase diagrams remain complete original sheets. Melia is hosted by Arada. Forest Signature Villa B prints 5,878 sq ft in Melia, Narenj and Anber, while its 2,504 + 2,294 + 999 components total 5,797. This 81 sq ft conflict remains unresolved. Coral supplies only Forest type A in the reviewed pack. Separate Narenj/Anber phase master plans were unavailable in these dedicated plan sources. Community diagrams retain their source revisions.
